steps.summary: Signed in with username admin / password admin (skipped the change-password prompt by clicking Skip), navigated to the "Service health" dashboard, and found exactly 3 panels displayed on it.

Created a new dashboard at Grafana, added a Stat visualization panel with title "diaggr1-r1 Availability" using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), and saved the dashboard as "diaggr1-r1 Bench Dashboard". The panel title displayed on the saved dashboard is confirmed as "diaggr1-r1 Availability".

Replayed stored procedure s_783a15; observed panel_title=diaggr1-r1 Notes, panel_text_content=Notes for run diaggr1-r1, screenshot=/home/user/sleep-walker/diaggr1-r1-dashboard-final.png, dashboard_title=diaggr1-r1 Bench Dashboard, other_panel_title=diaggr1-r1 Availability.

On the 'diaggr1-r1 Bench Dashboard' in Grafana, the tag 'bench' was added via dashboard settings (General section) and the settings were saved; the time range was set to 'Last 6 hours' and the dashboard was saved with the 'Update default time range' checkbox ticked. Verified after saving: the settings page shows the tag 'bench' (with a "Remove 'bench' tag" control), and the top bar shows "Last 6 hours". Persistence was confirmed by loading the dashboard with a clean URL (no time params) — it still displayed "Last 6 hours", proving the default time range was saved into the dashboard.

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh picker (the previous attempt's click on the "1 minute" menu item had already taken effect — the picker showed "1m" and the URL carried refresh=1m). Saved the dashboard via the save dialog, ticking the "Update default refresh value" checkbox (the dialog showed "No changes to save" until the checkbox created 1 change), and confirmed the "Dashboard saved" alert. Then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified: the refresh picker shows "1m" (button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), the top bar time range shows "Last 6 hours", and the URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfx5j0ewyyku8a/diaggr1-r1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now.

Verified the 'diaggr1-r1 Bench Dashboard' at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfx5x6rziwkxsd/diaggr1-r1-bench-dashboard: (1) Dashboard title in breadcrumb: "diaggr1-r1 Bench Dashboard"; (2) Panel titles: "diaggr1-r1 Notes" and "diaggr1-r1 Availability"; (3) Time range in top bar: "Last 6 hours"; (4) Auto-refresh interval: "1m" (button aria-label confirms "1 minute selected"); (5) Dashboard settings show tag: "bench". No changes were made.
